purpose: Teach: 検挙/記帳/投書/動議/募っ/危惧し/横ばい/雑多

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 創業期、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、不正を、絶対、検挙、絶対、する側に、絶対、立っていたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: From the very beginning, your father stood absolutely firm on the side of integrity — never wavering, never compromising.
lines.style: Slow, measured delivery. Each thought lands with deliberate weight. Slight pause between phrases. Voice carries the gravity of lived principle, not performance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、記帳、絶対、丁寧に、絶対、続けてまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Ever since my father's time, we've kept meticulous records with absolute care — that integrity has never been compromised.
lines.style: Formal but warm. Steady rhythm. Clear respect for the past layered into every clause. A son honoring his father's legacy, speaking with quiet certainty.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、お客様の、絶対、投書、絶対、自分で、絶対、目を通したぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father — he read every single customer letter himself. He didn't delegate that responsibility.
lines.style: Nostalgic, admiring tone. Slight lift in the voice on 「自分で」 — underlining the personal touch. Trailing thoughtfully, as if seeing him do it again.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、社員総会の、絶対、動議、絶対、丁寧に、絶対、扱ってまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's generation, we've handled every staff motion, every proposal with the same careful attention. That's the standard he set.
lines.style: Steady, respectful. Not defending — simply affirming. Each phrase deliberate. The voice of someone who understands what was passed to him and has carried it forward.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、人材を、絶対、募って、絶対、自ら、絶対、面接していたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father recruited talent personally. He conducted every interview himself.
lines.style: Admiring, slightly amazed tone. Each phrase stands alone. Slight emphasis on 「自ら」 — the personal commitment. Voice trails with quiet respect.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、業界の悪化を、絶対、危惧して、絶対、自社の、絶対、信頼性を、絶対、磨いてまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's time, we've watched the industry falter and worked harder to polish our own integrity — to be something people could trust even as everything around us shifted.
lines.style: Thoughtful, almost tender. The phrasing is longer here — giving it breath and consequence. A moment of real vulnerability under professional composure. Quiet conviction underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、業績、絶対、横ばい、絶対、の時期も、絶対、信念、絶対、貫いたぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Your father held to his principles even during the flat years — when the numbers weren't growing and it would have been easy to cut corners.
lines.style: Solemn, almost reverent. Slow pace. Heavy with meaning. The pause before 「信念」 lets it land. Trailing off with respect for an unflinching choice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの代から、本気で、絶対、雑多、絶対、な業務、絶対、整理、絶対、続けてまいりました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Since my father's time, we've kept our operations clean and orderly — never let the chaos of the market excuse disorder in how we work.
lines.style: Clear, grounded final statement. Not rushed. Each part spoken with quiet finality. The voice of someone closing a chapter with dignity and gratitude.
